title: What it ACTUALLY costs to run a Heat Pump (vs Gas Boiler)
summary: Octopus Energy video argues a heat pump on its smart heat pump tariff is cheaper to run than a gas boiler, though more expensive on a standard tariff.

assertions.quote: it's now cheaper to run a heat pump in your home than it is a gas boiler
running a heat pump on this standard tariff would cost an extra £78
shifted your electricity usage out of peak times you could save 220 compared to gas
you'll no longer have to pay a standing charge which can save you 115 lbs of year
a heat pump can last around 20 years
for every one unit of energy that you put into the system you'll achieve four units of heat
those who had other Green Tech like a battery for example made Savings of up to 27 %

verdicts.note: Among UK Cosy-tariff customers, some respond by charging and discharging a home battery, and there is suggestive evidence that battery cycling is an important part of the tariff effect for battery owners; the running-cost saving from the battery itself is not measured.

assertions.quote: just like boilers your heat pump will need to be serviced annually
